title: Nick Carter, Master Detective
paragraphs: Detective adventures featuring the long-established fictional sleuth Nick Carter, played on radio by Lon Clark as he tackles murders, disappearances, thefts, and elaborate criminal schemes.

Mutual detective series based on the long-running Street & Smith Nick Carter character. Lon Clark played Nick Carter throughout the radio run. Frozen GRH coverage contains 125 dated recordings from July 6, 1943 through December 25, 1949.
Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include murder and homicide, missing persons and kidnapping, theft and robbery, prison and criminal justice, and disguise and impersonation.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Nick Carter print-to-radio lineage, Long-running Mutual detective series, and 1944 fifteen-minute serial experiment.
